execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "public"."model_has_permissions" (
  "modelId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "modelType" text NOT NULL,
  "permissionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("permissionId", "modelId", "modelType")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."model_has_roles" (
  "modelId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "modelType" text NOT NULL,
  "roleId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("roleId", "modelId", "modelType")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."permissions" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "guardName" text DEFAULT 'web' NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."personal_access_tokens" (
  "ability" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastUsedAt" timestamptz,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "tokenableId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."role_has_permissions" (
  "permissionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "roleId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("permissionId", "roleId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."roles" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "guardName" text DEFAULT 'web' NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" uuid,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tenants" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerifiedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'Simple Agent' NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
